newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Munksjo to set up Polish corrugated board plant.
newsitem.headline: Munksjo to set up Polish corrugated board plant.

text.p: Munksjo packaging, a unit of Swedish forestry group Munksjo AB, will set up a new corrugated board plant in Pruszkow, Poland, Munksjo said on Tuesday.
The plant, which is expected to be operational at the beginning of 1998, will have an initial annual capacity of around 30,000 tonnes, the company said in a statement.

Munksjo believes that the corrugated board market in central and eastern Europe, particularly in Poland, will have continued strong growth and does not exclude further expansion in the region, the company said.
